# R5.14 — Required-grade pending: owner model (leg a of the `07b6be09` SPLIT)

**Summary.** Implements the owner-model leg of the admitted
required-grade `grade_pending` admission semantics (PADR-R5-1 §9.3,
admitted GATE-G9): `grade_pending` is an **admission state**, never a
seventh outcome class. The one admitted disposition function —
`hh-eval::selection::plan_disposition` — is now reachable through the
owner read `disposition::plan_disposition_at`, the producer ops
`settle_graded` / `record_selection_revision`, and the scheduler/close
owner callsites. Ticket `docs/tickets/183_R5.14__pending.md` (seq 183)
as rescoped by its dated amendment: **AC-1/AC-2 close at producer
scope here and discharge at consumer scope in seq 183a
(`183a_R5.14b__pending-consumers.md`); REQ-E-202/REQ-E-008 land
support-only — producer numbered checks, full predicates explicitly
owed, never stamped satisfied.** Scoped review verdict **SPLIT**
(X7's documented contingency), review record
`docs/build/planning/2026-11-02_R5.14b-split-review.md`.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-experiment/src/disposition.rs` (new) — the admitted read:
  `DispositionPins{experiment_until, overlay_runs}` (the read's
  reproducibility contract — equal pins → equal disposition, never
  writes); strict `spec.ext.required_grade` freeze decode
  (`{mode:"required", selection_policy_ref, tasks:{task:{oracle_ref,
  eligible[]}}}` — unknown mode/member/task → typed
  `UnknownRequiredFeature`, A.6); subject seal/stop/veto fold; durable
  `selection_revision` fold → `select_grade_at` → `plan_disposition`;
  `required_grade_freeze`, `recorded_disposition`, `validate_revision`.
- `crates/hh-experiment/src/engine.rs` — launch freezes
  `grade_binding{mode:"required", selection_policy_ref}` (task pins
  enforced; absent ext → byte-identical `mode:"legacy"`); `settle` in
  required mode appends `run_settled{grade_pending:true}` +
  `execution_settled{dedup_key}` once (execution cost exactly once;
  non-scored classes unchanged); **`settle_graded`** resolves and
  records `plan_disposition` — pending → no write, replay → verbatim
  (no second row, no recharge, no replan, no new n);
  **`record_selection_revision`** — the durable revision home,
  `RevisionLog`-validated (authorized, append-only, set-bound,
  watermark-bound, immutable); `close(false)` refuses
  `CloseBlocked{grade_pending=[…]}` naming slots; `close(true)`
  enumerates `ExperimentReport.pending`.
- `crates/hh-experiment/src/view.rs` — `PlanState.grade_pending` +
  disposition folds: pending blocks `eligible_at` (never relaunch),
  counts `open_at`/`pending_plans`; `PLAN_DISPOSITION` resolves the
  slot (graded-scored → accepted; oracle_failure/non-scored → final).
- `crates/hh-experiment/src/events.rs` + `errors.rs` — event builders
  (`grade_binding_frozen`, `execution_settled`, `plan_disposition`,
  `selection_revision`), additive `grade_pending`/`pending` members,
  `UnknownRequiredFeature` typed refusal.
- `crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` — three classes registered
  (`execution_settled`, `plan_disposition`, `selection_revision`;
  CC10) + `pending` audit member on `measurement.experiment.closed`.
- `crates/hh-eval/src/selection.rs` — **`cause_run` coordinate fix**:
  `run_id:event_id` parses on the LAST separator (run ids are
  colon-bearing — `subj-sha256:…`/`sha256:…` — the prefix split made
  every subject uncitable; `UncitedCauses` excluded all attempts, an
  unsatisfiable admitted contract). Same contract, correct parse —
  ADR-0393 D7.
- `crates/hh-experiment/tests/r5_14a.rs` — the producer battery
  (7 tests) over scratch stores: all eight ruling legs.
- `docs/adr/ADR-0393-r5.14-required-grade-pending-owner-landing.md` —
  landing decisions incl. the `cause_run` fix, the
  `ConflictingCoordinate` multi-member note and the **R5.9 revisit
  flag**; ADR index + REVISIT_TRIGGERS regenerated; BL-47 sources.

## Design decisions

- One read, one write path: consumers in seq 183a compose the same
  `plan_disposition_at` — no second selection implementation (CC1).
- `settle_graded` never re-executes: grading reads durable rows;
  execution cost was settled once by `settle`.
- Unknown required features refuse at launch — never a silent
  downgrade to legacy.
